task_summary: Carry out owner-controlled fan trials, implement the explicitly requested 50-percent limit, and analyze installation-fault evidence without claiming an unmeasured physical diagnosis.

acceptance: Use parked confirmed settings and keep vehicle activation with the owner.
For the requested higher limit, preserve the exact previous source and verify the new binary before authorized flashing.
Correlate raw records and owner observations, then clear the temporary target and distinguish findings from hypotheses.
completed: 10 and 15 percent settings were acknowledged; owner reported no physical rotation.
Owner-requested 50 percent firmware changed one definition; host tests, official build, independent review and memory readback passed.
50 percent produced owner-observed shudder or abnormal noise; further upward trials stopped.
Actual record contained an approximately 33-second 50-percent request interval, exceeding the planned two-second manual test.
Final setting and output both zero, run flag zero, acknowledged twice; serial connection closed.
Low voltage observation was reconciled with owner-confirmed manual power removal; no causal supply-fault claim.
remaining: Physical cause of failed fan startup remains unresolved; requires installation inspection and actual electrical measurements.

metrics.name: observed_interval
metrics.basis: First recorded clock to cutoff; includes owner actions, waiting, three trial levels, firmware build and diagnostic review.

metrics.name: native_workers
metrics.basis: One independent reviewer and one host-test implementer; no actual Opus call.

metrics.name: firmware_changed_files
metrics.basis: Compared with exact flashed baseline; maximum trial throttle definition only.

metrics.name: host_groups
metrics.basis: Real extracted C functions with hardware stubs.

metrics.name: target_build
metrics.basis: Official ADS log; excludes IDE startup/import.

metrics.name: flash_duration
metrics.basis: Programmer log, not total workflow duration.

metrics.name: vehicle_start_commands
metrics.basis: Owner used the physical S5 button; agent sent configuration and query commands only.

metrics.name: capture_gap
metrics.basis: Between the two 10-percent capture windows; not continuous coverage.

metrics.name: review_overhead
metrics.basis: Not separately measured; archive receipt measures only the post-cutoff interval.

observations: Current serial transport changed from downloader to wireless; one attempted stale COM6 open failed before sending anything.
Mixed binary telemetry prefixed a valid fan reply; line-start anchoring incorrectly missed it. Local parser now recognizes the literal fan token regardless of prefix.
One guarded setup query received no acknowledgement; no setting was sent in that attempt.
One cleanup attempt sent zero but lacked a successful acknowledgement; fresh readback and an idempotent retry subsequently verified zero.
Host tests first encountered a WSL access denial before compilation; the same authorized execution then passed.
The three physical trials were not matched conditions: wheel-drive state differed and a timer reset occurred in the 15-percent capture.
A long IMU calibration interval also occurred with zero fan output, so it cannot independently establish vibration from faulty installation.
Manual timing did not enforce the intended two-second powered trial; software request duration must be reported honestly.

recommendations.action: Before further powered diagnosis, provide a dedicated fan-only test with MCU-enforced timeout and wheel-output inhibition instead of relying on the full launch workflow and manual timing.
recommendations.next_check: Test expiry and cancellation independently clear fan output and cannot launch the wheels.

recommendations.action: Use the actually enumerated transport, parse mixed binary/text tokens, and separate device-time resets and capture gaps.
recommendations.next_check: Next analysis does not merge rebooted camera rows or infer continuous coverage across gaps.

recommendations.action: Treat a zero-setting command as incomplete until its target, output and launch-state readback all confirm the stopped state.
recommendations.next_check: Final handoff cites the successful fresh acknowledgement, retaining failed attempts separately.

limits: No measured control waveform at the ESC, phase current, tachometer, impeller-clearance or connector-continuity evidence.
Firmware output is a command, not measured power or physical rotation.
Software and programming checks passed; physical fan startup did not.
No matched workflow baseline; net efficiency remains unproven.
